crop.notes: Column of theatre ads; only the final Theatre Comique 'Extra Notice' is about Allen. The May Howard and first Theatre Comique ads are unrelated.

summary.suggested: The Missouri Republican carried a Theatre Comique notice that referee Tom Allen, after the Carteron–Rigal wrestling match went undecided on Tuesday, ruled it would be finished on Thursday evening, February 10.

metadata.notes: Page header reads 'The St. Louis Republican, Wednesday Morning, February 9, 1876'; filed as Missouri Republican per the pre-1888 rule. Not 'The St. Louis Republic'.

facts.fact: Allen refereed the wrestling match between Carteron and Rigal at the Theatre Comique, St. Louis; when it went undecided after a long struggle he ruled it would be decided on Thursday, February 10
places: Theatre Comique, Pine Street between Third and Fourth, St. Louis
